name: todoist
about: My to-do list for literally everything: school, home, and personal stuff. School is the number one thing I use it for. I’ve been using it since high school and pay for the monthly subscription because I love how I can organize everything.

shots.alt: my Todoist college tasks list with classes and due dates
my Todoist upcoming view laid out as a weekly calendar

name: beeper
about: If you haven’t heard of it, Beeper connects all your other messaging apps into one app. I use it on my MacBook and iPhone so I don’t need the social media apps on my phone and can still message everybody.

shots.alt: my Beeper inbox on Mac, with every conversation blurred
Beeper on three phones showing connected networks and a combined inbox

name: copilot money
about: How I manage my finances. I like that I can connect all my credit cards, bank accounts, and investing accounts in one place.

shots.alt: my Copilot Money dashboard with all amounts and accounts blurred
Copilot Money on four phones showing budgets and spending

name: obsidian
about: My note-taking app. Sometimes I pair it with a drawing tablet to take notes in my classes. I like it because everything is stored locally, and you can really customize it and use it however you want.

shots.alt: my Obsidian notes for an engineering exam with handwritten annotations
Obsidian on Mac showing a graph view, and on iPhone showing a daily note

name: notion
about: I use Notion for personal stuff, club work, and keeping track of my calendars and all my events.

shots.alt: my Notion task board for TAMU ColorStack
the LeetRoom Lessons gallery in the TAMU ColorStack Notion
